topics.title: Das Oktoberfest startet
topics.englishContext: Munich’s Oktoberfest is often called the Wiesn. It is a large public festival with traditional clothing, festival tents, food, music and fairground rides. You do not need to drink alcohol to visit; many people go simply to see the atmosphere.

interestingFacts.de: Das Oktoberfest 2026 findet vom 19. September bis zum 4. Oktober auf der Theresienwiese in München statt.
interestingFacts.en: Oktoberfest 2026 takes place from 19 September to 4 October on Munich’s Theresienwiese.

guides.title: Oktoberfest 2026: Offizielle Informationen
guides.summary: Opening times, visitor information and important dates from the official Oktoberfest website.

topics.title: Herbstfeste und Kirmes
topics.englishContext: Many towns and cities hold local autumn festivals or funfairs in September. They are a relaxed way to spend time with friends or family, try local food and enjoy rides, music or market stalls.

topics.title: Die Kürbiszeit beginnt
topics.englishContext: Pumpkins are a common autumn ingredient in Germany. You will see them in supermarkets, markets, bakeries and restaurant menus. Pumpkin soup and roasted vegetables are especially popular.

interestingFacts.de: Beim Hokkaido-Kürbis kann man die Schale meist mitessen. Man muss ihn nur gut waschen.
interestingFacts.en: With a Hokkaido pumpkin, you can usually eat the skin too. Just wash it well.

topics.title: Jacke am Morgen, Sonne am Nachmittag
topics.englishTitle: A Jacket in the Morning, Sunshine in the Afternoon
topics.englishContext: September weather can change a lot during one day. A light jacket or layers are practical because mornings may feel cool while afternoons can still be warm and sunny.
